description: Floating action that reveals a set of related actions.

howToUse: Use it when the main action of the screen has three to five variants: new note, new photo, new list.
List them in `actions` with short labels, and give the closed button a `label` ("Create").
alternatives: Places people visit, not actions: Sidebar or NavigationMenu.

keyboard.action: Goes to the first or last action.
Closes the menu and returns focus to the button.

props.name: actions
props.description: Three to five short actions is the recommended use.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the closed trigger.
